description_en: Transfers the visual style of a specified style image to an input image, transforming visual attributes such as color and brushstrokes
description_zh: 将输入图按照指定的风格图像进行风格的迁移，使得图像的色彩、笔触等视觉风格发生转化
name: ExtendImageStyle

parameters.description_en: The URL of the style image. The URL must be publicly accessible and can be up to 8 KB in length.
parameters.description_zh: 风格图片URL地址，必须是公网可以正常访问的地址，最长8K。
parameters.help_en: The URL of the style image. The URL must be publicly accessible and can be up to 8 KB in length
